subject: general
question: Which of the following options best describes the main function of an operating system?

options.text: Managing computer hardware and software resources

solution:
The correct answer is __**Managing computer hardware and software resources**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **An operating system (OS)** is the core software that manages computer hardware and software resources efficiently.
 
• It acts as a **bridge between the user and the computer hardware**, enabling communication and execution of tasks.
 
• **Primary functions** include managing memory allocation, process scheduling, and storage devices.
 
• Operating systems provide a platform for running applications and ensure that resources are distributed fairly among processes.
 
• Examples of widely used operating systems include **Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kernel:** The core component of an operating system that manages system resources and hardware communication.
 
• **Types of Operating Systems:** Includes batch OS, multitasking OS, distributed OS, real-time OS, and network OS.
 
• **Process Management:** The OS schedules and coordinates processes to ensure efficient execution and resource utilization.
 
• **File System Management:** The OS organizes, stores, and retrieves files on storage devices using file systems like NTFS, FAT32, or ext4.
 
• **Virtual Memory:** A technique used by the OS to extend the physical memory by using disk space as temporary memory.
